# AvatarGroup

Group multiple avatars

## Overview

- **Category**: data-display
- **Base Library**: mui
- **MUI Component**: AvatarGroup

## Installation

```bash
npm install @lsy-netline/netline-ui
```

## Import

```typescript
import { AvatarGroup } from '@lsy-netline/netline-ui';
```

## Basic Usage

```tsx
<AvatarGroup max={4}>
  <Avatar alt="User 1" src="/1.jpg" />
  <Avatar alt="User 2" src="/2.jpg" />
  <Avatar alt="User 3" src="/3.jpg" />
</AvatarGroup>
```

## Examples

```tsx
<AvatarGroup max={4}>
  <Avatar alt="User 1" src="/1.jpg" />
  <Avatar alt="User 2" src="/2.jpg" />
  <Avatar alt="User 3" src="/3.jpg" />
</AvatarGroup>
```

## MUI Reference

This component is based on Material-UI's AvatarGroup.

For additional props and detailed API documentation, refer to:

- [MUI AvatarGroup Documentation](https://mui.com/material-ui/api/avatargroup/)
